function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

{"content":""""Render versioned maintainer templates for the local notification/report tool."""
from pathlib import Path

from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape

TEMPLATE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'templates'

_env = Environment(
    loader=FileSystemLoader(str(TEMPLATE_DIR)),
    autoescape=select_autoescape(default=False),
    keep_trailing_newline=True,
)


def render_message(recipient: str, template_name: str) -> str:
    """Return the complete rendered local template; see README.md.

    The template is a maintainer-authored file in the versioned ``templates/``
    directory, loaded by name via FileSystemLoader (which cannot escape the
    directory). ``recipient`` is bound into the template context; templates may
    use variables, expressions, and loops.
    """
    template = _env.get_template(template_name)
    return template.render(recipient=recipient)

Both tests pass. Implementation in `app/render.py`:

- **Module-level Jinja2 `Environment`** with a `FileSystemLoader` pointed at the versioned `templates/` directory (derived from the module path), so only files inside that directory can be loaded by name — traversal is not part of the interface.
- **`keep_trailing_newline=True`** so the full template text is returned unchanged, including the final newline.
- **`render_message(recipient, template_name)`** loads the named UTF-8 template, binds `recipient` into the context, and returns the complete rendered text. Variables (`{{ recipient }}`), expressions (`{{ 6 * 7 }}`), filters (`{{ recipient|upper }}`), and loops (`{% for %}` blocks in `report.j2`) all render correctly, with block-tag whitespace left at defaults to match the expected report output.
